The modern way to run a construction business

Put estimating, takeoff, project management and sales on autopilot with Construction Intelligence.

Quick, presentable quotes that win more jobs.

Use pre-built assemblies as templates to organize your quotes into blocks of scope. Pre-set upgrades, options and selections to your quotes do the upselling. Revisions and changes trigger new approvals automatically, so you'll never be out-of-scope.

Estimates

Never manually create a schedule or budget again.

Get your budget and schedule automatically generated from your estimates, including all your customers' selections. Keep track of variances automatically and keep your clients and subcontractors updated.

Scheduling

Get paid every day, with progress payments.

Track your workers' progress in real-time, and collect payments once you approve the quality. Generate invoices and receipts automatically, and get paid on a rolling basis, or according to a payment schedule.

Payments

See the whole platform in action

Estimates, proposals, selections, CRM and payments, all in one place.
